selection.rule: For each explicitly selected new title and technique, select first numeric clip 0000 in Control_Group and technique_Group. These six selections are fixed before downloading labels or seeing model results. If a path does not exist, enumerate that exact group and use its first numeric clip; record substitution. No output-driven selection or exclusion. If fewer than 30 non-special word occurrences across six clips, add first indexed clip 0001 for all control groups; mark additional set separately.
selection.reason: Three different songs and three distinct techniques; paired control and modified performances test duration variation. Same singer limitation explicitly retained.

referenceMethod: External published GTSinger word/phoneme annotations, MFA initialized and manually corrected by authors using listening and spectrograms. Not annotations generated by our karaoke models or our own listening. Absolute annotation error bound not published; quality flags retained. Ground truth frozen before any new v3/v4 predictions.
